title: Enterprise Customer Success Manager
rationale: Owns adoption and renewal for Harvey's enterprise legal accounts, the closest match to her Dolce and Gabbana portfolio, QBR and expansion work, Tier 1 customer success with no PM or engineering screen.

title: Majors Customer Success Manager (Asset Management)
rationale: Tier 1 customer success role for Harvey's largest accounts, same adoption and renewal motion as her D&G portfolio, gap is the asset management and Fortune 500 vertical depth the posting prefers.

title: Forward Deployed Product Manager, Enterprise
rationale: Titled product manager but the requirements accept a customer-facing product ownership background as an alternative to a PM title, which is exactly her sell-in tool product ownership, Tier 1 deployment ownership with a moderate PM-screen risk.

title: Mid-Market Customer Success Manager
rationale: Same Tier 1 CSM motion as the other two Harvey rows, a mid-market book of 40 plus clients rather than a handful of majors, the volume of concurrent accounts is the one thing she has not run at this scale.

title: Forward Deployed Product Manager, AI Agent
rationale: Titled forward deployed but the requirements are technology consulting, implementations and customer success with the FDEs doing the heavy build, so Tier 1 deployment ownership, gap is direct AI agent building experience.

title: GTM Technology Product Owner
rationale: Titled GTM but the requirements are internal systems ownership, data integrity and dedup, exactly her sell-in tool product-owner work, not GTM strategy, so scored as her old-job tier rather than the GTM tier.

title: Associate Forward Deployed Product Manager
rationale: Entry-level forward deployed PM, the stated qualifying background explicitly includes consulting and customer or sales engineer roles with a low technical bar, gap is that the scope is more junior than her current seniority.

title: Enterprise Account Manager
rationale: Enterprise account retention and expansion at a developer-tools AI company, close to her CSM background, gap is the coding-familiarity the posting prefers and no account-manager title at a software company.

title: Senior Solutions Engineer
rationale: Titled solutions engineer but the requirements are pre-sales discovery and demo building rather than a hard engineering bar, so Tier 1 solutions consulting, gap is the 4 to 6 years of dedicated pre-sales experience she does not have.

title: Program Manager, GTM Systems
rationale: Cross-functional GTM systems coordination close to her single-point-of-contact role at LVMH, Tier 2 GTM, gap is no formal program manager or RevOps systems title and the GTM function itself remains a gap.

title: Revenue Strategy & Operations Manager
rationale: Tier 2 RevOps role owning GTM KPIs and reporting, overlaps with her account health monitoring tool work, gap is the RevOps or investment banking background the posting prefers and the GTM title itself.

title: Manager, Customer Success - Beneficial Deployments
rationale: Tier 1 CSM work managing a nonprofit account portfolio, but requires 3 plus years directly managing a CSM team, which is not on her record despite her field enablement experience, named as the gap.

title: GTM Enablement Manager
location: New York, NY (hybrid, one of NYC, Nashville, SF or Mountain View)
rationale: Tier 2 product enablement translating releases into field-ready training, overlaps with her field rollout and training work, gap is no formal enablement or product marketing title.

title: Private Equity Partnerships Manager
rationale: Tier 2 quota-carrying partnerships role, requires private equity fund economics fluency and a partnerships or BD title she does not have, a wider gap than the usual GTM adjacency.

title: Strategic Solutions Engineer, East
rationale: Tier 1 solutions engineering title but the requirements lean on contact center and telephony architecture depth, SIP, CCaaS, IVR, that she has not worked with, a real technical gap beyond the usual sales-engineering overlap.

title: Technical Deployment Lead, Forward Deployed Engineering (FDE) - NYC
rationale: Titled as a deployment lead but the day to day is running engineering execution across a team of Forward Deployed Engineers, capped for requiring engineering management she has not done, logged weak rather than dropped because the customer-delivery leadership overlap is real.
